identification: Microsoft Chat Customizations Evaluations VS Code extension 1.1.2026102017

decisive_evidence.manifest_diff: Only release version and devDependencies.vitest (^4.1.9 -> ^4.1.11). preinstall remains cd client && npm install.
decisive_evidence.other_changes: VSIX identity version, backup package manifest Vitest declaration, generated third-party dependency notices.
decisive_evidence.queue_premise_refuted: The earlier release also produces the install-hook suspicion with the same rules and engine. The hook and every JavaScript/source-map member are unchanged; the queue difference is not newly introduced execution.

reverse_engineering: Startup activation creates a VS Code LanguageClient, registers commands/providers and starts the shipped server over IPC. Neither activation nor the server invokes npm preinstall.

Analysis commands pass the selected open prompt document to the language server. It builds an analysis request, proxies through vscode.lm/selectChatModels/sendRequest, and publishes diagnostics. Fix commands open VS Code chat with the selected file and diagnostic suggestions.

Waza commands resolve the selected skill/evaluation, run the configured executable via spawn(command, argv, {cwd, stdio}), capture its output, and optionally request evaluation recommendations. The shell is not enabled by this executor.

Missing Waza binary fallback obtains the Microsoft Waza release tag over HTTPS, downloads a platform/architecture binary and checksums.txt, verifies SHA-256, copies into extension globalStorage/bin, chmods to decimal 493 (0755) on non-Windows, then launches the managed path.

Source package preinstall only descends into client and resolves declared language-client dependencies. The shipped client manifest has compile/watch/lint scripts and no npm install lifecycle payload.
Hashing also fingerprints document snapshots; Node random/pipe/env handling is vendored LSP runtime plumbing.
The bundle is conventional esbuild CommonJS with TypeScript helpers. The recovered Unicode layer is a UI checkmark in the scaffold-created message, not executable concealment.

GitHub app-runtime and react-core are Rspack website modules implementing GitHub page routing, UI, requests and performance instrumentation. Atomscan fetched them by following the repository page; no extension path imports those web assets.

No evidence of a malicious payload, credential harvesting, covert exfiltration, persistence outside normal extension activation, or unauthorized consumer-project rewriting was found. Verdict rests on traced purpose-aligned behavior and byte-level release comparison, not scan absence.
missing_context: No host deployment history, user configuration, executed Waza binary, or model-service runtime response was supplied. These unknowns do not establish compromise of this VSIX.

changes.claim_corrected: A complete bare install inside an owned child directory is not a supply-chain attack objective.
changes.implementation: Add notable lifecycle metadata for an anchored whole-script child install and exclude only that shape from preinstall-runs-npm-install. Named installs, parent segments, shell expansion and chained commands do not qualify. The install-hook aggregate stops firing only because its unsupported atom no longer matches.

changes.claim_corrected: Checksum verification failed does not identify AKM.
changes.implementation: Move unchanged matcher and effective scope to micro-behaviors/ui/keywords::checksum-verification-failure-message; update the AKM composite. Broad AKM identity exclusions intentionally no longer treat the generic message as product identity, restoring JSON/token parsing observations.

changes.claim_corrected: publisher: ms-vscode does not identify Remote Server.
changes.implementation: Move the unchanged publisher matcher to metadata/package/vendor::ms-vscode-publisher; update Remote Tunnels and Debug Value Editor consumers. Real product composites retain their full conditions.

changes.implementation: Relocate unchanged matcher/scope to metadata/lang/source/naming/interface::browser-recording-workflow-name and update the Selenium consumer. This also leaves lifecycle at its existing 100-rule budget; no budget was raised.
